snippet.title: Ciri Ciri Kiamat, Matahari Terbit dari Barat | Akhir Zaman Episode 6
snippet.description:
Matahari terbit dari barat. Pagi itu semua orang langsung beriman, tapi pintu taubat udah ketutup.

Episode 6 dari 10 seri animasi Kalau Lu Hidup di Akhir Zaman. Pagi itu langit timur tetap gelap. Satu menit, sepuluh menit. Lalu ada yang teriak dari belakang lu, dan lu nengok ke barat, ke arah Laut Tengah. Matahari terbit dari arah dia biasa tenggelam. Yang tadinya ngeledek agama sekarang sujud, yang tadinya nunda taubat sekarang nangis. Tapi iman yang baru muncul pagi itu udah nggak berguna lagi. Di waktu dhuha, keluar binatang dari bumi yang ngomong ke manusia.

Di video ini:
• Tanda kiamat besar: matahari terbit dari barat
• Kenapa iman dan taubat nggak diterima lagi setelah itu (QS. Al-An'am 158)
• Pintu taubat yang ketutup, dan siapa yang amalnya tetap dihitung
• Dabbatul ardh, binatang yang keluar dari bumi di waktu dhuha
• Kenapa bentuk dabbah nggak perlu ditebak-tebak

Rujukan:
QS. Al-An'am 158: tidak berguna lagi iman seseorang yang belum beriman sebelumnya
HR. Bukhari 4635: saat matahari terbit dari barat dan manusia melihatnya, semua beriman
HR. Muslim 2941: tanda pertama yang keluar adalah matahari terbit dari barat dan keluarnya dabbah di waktu dhuha
QS. An-Naml 82: binatang dari bumi yang berbicara kepada manusia

Catatan: dabbah tidak digambar di video karena Al-Qur'an dan hadis sahih tidak menjelaskan bentuknya. Urutan kejadian di seri ini salah satu cara menyusun riwayat. Kota lu di video ini kota fiktif di Syam.

snippet.title: A mathematician said it couldn't exist. A homemaker found it. #math #tiling #pentagon #mathhistory
snippet.description:
In 1968, Richard Kershner of Johns Hopkins announced a complete list of the convex pentagons that can tile a floor: eight kinds. A complete proof, he wrote, "would require a rather large book." Martin Gardner printed the list in his Scientific American column in July 1975, and within a month a reader, Richard James, mailed in a ninth.

Marjorie Rice, a 52-year-old San Diego homemaker and mother of five, read the column in her son's copy of the magazine. She had no mathematical training beyond a general math course in high school, so she invented her own notation: little pentagons with arcs showing which corners meet. She worked at the kitchen counter while her family was out; her daughter Kathy says, "I thought she was just doodling." Within months she had a new kind of pentagon. Gardner sent it to Doris Schattschneider, who confirmed it was new. Rice went on to find four new types in all: 9, 11, 12 and 13 (1976 to 1977).

In 2017, Michaël Rao used a computer to check every possibility and showed there are exactly 15 kinds of convex pentagon that tile the plane (a computer-assisted proof, still a preprint; Thomas Hales independently reproduced its first half). Four of the 15 are hers. The lobby floor of the Mathematical Association of America in Washington is a tiling she found (1999).

The tiles in the video are computed, not drawn by eye: a Type 9 pentagon (angles 105°, 75.7°, 150°, 58.6°, 150.7°, four equal sides) and a patch of 38 tiles laid edge to edge, where every corner adds up to 360°.

On screen
• 3 × 108° = 324°: three regular pentagons leave 36° of floor (arithmetic)
• Reinhardt, 1918: five kinds · R. B. Kershner, Johns Hopkins, 1968
• Martin Gardner, Scientific American, July 1975 · Richard James's 9th, printed Dec 1975
• Marjorie Rice, 52 · San Diego · "no mathematical training beyond a general math course in high school" (D. Schattschneider)
• Done "without her family's knowledge" (Schattschneider) · "I thought she was just doodling." (her daughter, Kathy)
• Gardner → Doris Schattschneider, Feb 1976 · Her four: Types 9, 11, 12, 13 · 1976 to 1977
• 2017 · Michaël Rao: computer-assisted proof (preprint; first half independently reproduced by Thomas Hales)

Sources
• Doris Schattschneider, "Marjorie Rice and Her Pentagonal Tilings", Bridges 2018: https://archive.bridgesmathart.org/2018/bridges2018-1.pdf
• Natalie Wolchover, "Marjorie Rice's Secret Pentagons", Quanta, July 11, 2017: https://www.quantamagazine.org/marjorie-rices-secret-pentagons-20170711/
• Natalie Wolchover, "Pentagon Tiling Proof Solves Century-Old Math Problem", Quanta, July 11, 2017: https://www.quantamagazine.org/pentagon-tiling-proof-solves-century-old-math-problem-20170711/
• Chuanming Zong, "Can You Pave the Plane Nicely with Identical Tiles" (quotes Kershner's 1968 introduction), arXiv:1803.06610: https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.06610
• CNRS, "There are only 15 possible pentagonal tiles" (2017): https://cnrs.fr/en/node/2413
• Wikipedia, Pentagonal tiling (the 15 types and their conditions): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pentagonal_tiling
• Ivars Peterson, "Tiling with Pentagons", The Mathematical Tourist, June 2010: https://mathtourist.blogspot.com/2010/06/tiling-with-pentagons.html

Abdul El-Sayed just won Michigan's U.S. Senate election.

But an interview he gave to Jesse Watters back in August raises an interesting question about where he stands on the Second Amendment.

Watters asked whether El-Sayed wanted to replace the constitutional right to bear arms.

Instead of answering yes or no, El-Sayed pivoted to healthcare.

Then, when pressed again, he talked about being comfortable with people owning hunting rifles.

**But does supporting hunting rifles answer the larger constitutional question?**

In this video, I revisit the interview and examine the difference between supporting the Second Amendment, supporting certain types of gun ownership, and advocating changes to the Constitution.

We also discuss an older statement attributed to El-Sayed about replacing the right to bear arms with a right to healthcare.

His campaign has said those earlier comments don't reflect his current views.

So what should people make of the exchange?

And why does it matter now that he's been elected to the Senate?

Because senators help shape federal firearms policy and vote on the confirmation of federal judges who interpret constitutional rights.

**Do you think El-Sayed answered Watters' Second Amendment question, or did he leave his position unclear?**

Watch the exchange and tell me what you think.

snippet.description:
Cheese Bread Pocket Hack! (Turning Young Mockery into Legendary Vintage Redemption!) 👑🧀✨

Ingredients

Bread Slices (ബ്രെഡ്) – As needed

Boiled Potatoes (വേവിച്ച ഉരുളക്കിഴങ്ങ്) – 3 to 4 (mashed)

Chopped Onions, Capsicum & Green Chillies – For filling

Pepper Powder, Chilli Flakes & Salt – To taste

Mozzarella Cheese (മോസറെല്ല ചീസ്) – Grated

Flour Slurry & Breadcrumbs – For coating

Oil – For frying

How to Prepare

Mash boiled potatoes and mix with chopped onions, capsicum, green chillies, spices, and mozzarella cheese to make a thick, cheesy filling.

Flatten fresh bread slices after removing the edges, fill with the potato-cheese mixture, fold into triangular pockets, and seal.

Coat each pocket in a light flour slurry and roll generously in breadcrumbs.

Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy, cut open to reveal the cheese pull, and win the competition trophy in style!

snippet.description:
全国的に規模が大きい地震が続いている中、国は今月（11月）、災害対応の「司令塔」となる新たな組織「防災庁」を発足させました。今、私たちの身を守るために、必要なこととは…。

　11月8日の未明に発生した、愛知県東部を震源とする地震。愛知県では約30年ぶりに震度5強を観測し、愛知県と静岡県で合わせて24人のケガ人が出ました。

కరకరలాడే మరియు పొరలు పొరలుగా వచ్చే సంప్రదాయ చిరోటి (Chiroti) తయారీ విధానం! కర్ణాటక మరియు మహారాష్ట్ర స్టైల్‌లో ఈ రుచికరమైన స్వీట్‌ను ఇంట్లోనే సులభంగా ఎలా తయారు చేయాలో ఈ వీడియోలో చూడండి.
​Traditional Karnataka–Maharashtra style Chiroti featuring delicate flaky layers, a golden crispy finish, and a generous dusting of aromatic powdered sugar. Perfect for festivals and special occasions!
​📌 Recipe Highlights:
​Dough Preparation: Fine semolina, salt, ghee, and water.
​The Secret Paste: Rice flour & ghee mixture for perfect, flaky layers.
​Frying: Cooked to a golden crisp in medium heat.
​Finishing: Dusting with powdered sugar and cardamom powder.

snippet.description:
ஒரு தந்தையின் வாழ்க்கையில் மாற்றத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியது அவருடைய மகளின் கண்ணீர்! ❤️
தனது குடிப்பழக்கத்தால் மகளுக்கு ஏற்பட்ட அவமானத்தை உணர்ந்த ராமசாமி, இனிமேல் வாழ்க்கையை மாற்றிக்கொள்ள முடிவு செய்கிறார். மகளுக்காக அன்புடன் ஒரு ஸ்பெஷலான விருந்து தயார் செய்கிறார்.
முழு நாட்டுக்கோழிக்குள் சுவையான பாசுமதி பிரியாணியை ஸ்டஃப் செய்து, பாரம்பரிய முறையில் மண்பானையில் விறகடுப்பில் சமைக்கும் இந்த வித்தியாசமான சமையலைக் கடைசி வரை பாருங்க! 😍🔥
ஒரு குழந்தையின் கண்ணீரை விட பெரிய அவமானம் எதுவுமில்லை. குடும்பத்திற்காக மாற நினைக்கும் ஒவ்வொரு மனிதருக்கும் இந்தக் கதை ஒரு நினைவூட்டல்! ❤️
